mission: Let the ops-write preflight run, and make two session-14 numbers readable over REST. The preflight's delivery check listed .github/workflows/staging-delivery.yml, which is workflow_call only and has no runs endpoint (GitHub answers 404), so every ops-write dispatch was refused with 'GitHub read failed' (run 38899254401). Drop that entry; ci.yml delivery jobs and Verify staging merge are still checked and any read error still refuses. The staging-state and official-images-status ops-summary annotations gain the quarantined-refresh-work count/oldest blocked-since and the recent mirror runs' start times. Staging only; no collector, setting, price, identity, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no deploy, enqueue or runbook run in this PR.

impacts.reason: DELIVERY_WORKFLOWS no longer lists staging-delivery.yml (workflow_call only, no runs of its own, so its runs endpoint 404s and the fail-closed preflight refused every write runbook). The ci.yml staging-automerge/staging-credential-presence jobs and staging-verify.yml runs are still checked; any read error still refuses. Quiet windows, owner approval (staging-ops) and the apply/sha checks are unchanged.

Read-only summaries only: staging-state adds quarantined_refresh_work {count, oldest_blocked_since} from the snapshot's blocker; official-images-status adds recent_runs (status, createdAt of the last 5 Railway runs it already reads). No new query, request or write.
Asserts every DELIVERY_WORKFLOWS entry has a trigger besides workflow_call, and covers the two new summary fields.
Documents the new summary fields and why Serialized staging delivery is not in the delivery check.

resources.name: GitHub Actions: ops-write preflight and ops-readonly summaries (scripts/ops)

impact.deployment_impact: Ops tooling, test and doc only. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/, apps/ or .github/ changes.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR restores the old delivery list (ops-write then refuses again) and the shorter summaries. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: An ops-write preflight that passes while a staging-automerge, staging-credential-presence or Verify staging merge run is queued or running.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: an ops-write enqueue-remaining-50 dry run passes its preflight and its owner-approval job waits for the owner; staging-state and official-images-status summaries show the new fields.
